# Commands

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_docs.py from code, do not edit. -->

Built-in Uroboros commands. The default prefix is a dot; change it with `.setprefix`. Access is who besides this account may run the command (see [Security](security.md)); change it with `.security <command> <level>`.

## Backup

Back up and restore the database and modules

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 💾 `.backup [auto [hours \| off] [keep]]` | back up the DB and modules to Saved Messages; auto — on a schedule | owners |
| ♻️ `.restore [-f] (reply to a backup)` | restore the DB and modules and restart; -f — foreign backup or dangerous code | owners |

## Config

Module settings

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| ⚙️ `.cfg [module] [key] [value]` (`.config`) | view or change settings | owners |
| ↩️ `.rcfg <module> <key>` | reset a setting to its default | owners |

## Diagnostics

Diagnostics: what failed to load and why, command statistics

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 🩺 `.doctor` | what failed to load, inline bot state, changed files, frozen modules | owners |
| 📊 `.stats [module \| reset]` | command calls and timings, errors, flood freezes since start | owners |

## Eval

Run Python code and shell commands

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 🐍 `.e <code>` (`.eval`) | run Python code (client, message, reply, db, loader are available) | owners |
| 💻 `.t <command>` (`.terminal`) | run a shell command | owners |

## Help

Help on modules and commands

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 📖 `.help [module or command]` (`.modules`) | list modules or help on one | support |

## InlineBot

Inline bot: buttons and forms

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 🤖 `.inlinebot [token \| new \| on \| off]` | inline bot state, your own token, a new bot, turn on or off | owners |

## Loader

Install and remove modules, GitHub repos

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 🔗 `.addrepo <owner/repo \| link>` | connect a GitHub module repo | owners |
| ✂️ `.delrepo <owner/repo>` | disconnect a repo | owners |
| 📥 `.dlm [-f] <link \| owner/repo/module \| module>` | install a module; -f — without confirmation | owners |
| 📎 `.lm [-f] (reply to a file or with a file)` | install a module from a file; -f — without confirmation | owners |
| 🔁 `.reload` | reload all modules | owners |
| 📚 `.repos` | connected repos | sudo |
| 🔎 `.search <query>` | find a module in connected repos | sudo |
| 🗑 `.ulm <module>` | remove a module | owners |
| 🔃 `.uplm [-f] [module]` | update third-party modules: changes and confirmation first; -f — right away | owners |

## Security

Access: owners, sudo, support and command permissions

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 👑 `.owner [add \| del] [user]` | owners: full access, like this account | owners |
| 🔐 `.security [command level \| flood ... \| unfreeze module \| trust/untrust module \| log]` | access and protection | owners |
| 🛡 `.sudo [add \| del] [user]` | sudo: all commands except owner commands | owners |
| 🤝 `.support [add \| del] [user]` | support: only support-level commands | owners |

## Settings

Prefix, aliases, re-running edited commands and the bot language

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 🏷 `.alias <alias> <command>` | add an alias | owners |
| 🏷 `.aliases` | list aliases | sudo |
| ✏️ `.editcmd [on \| off]` | re-run a command when its message is edited | owners |
| 🌐 `.lang [ru \| en]` | bot interface language | owners |
| ⌨️ `.setprefix <prefix>` | change the command prefix | owners |
| 🗑 `.unalias <alias>` | remove an alias | owners |

## System

State, restart and updates

| Command | Description | Access |
|---|---|---|
| 🌿 `.dev [on \| off] [-f]` | bot branch: on — dev build (new, before testing), off — back to master | owners |
| ℹ️ `.info` | about this userbot | support |
| 📝 `.logs [level]` | send logs as a file to Saved Messages (debug, info, warning, error, critical) | owners |
| 📡 `.ping` | latency to Telegram | support |
| 🔄 `.restart` | restart the userbot | owners |
| 🆕 `.update [-f \| channel stable\|beta \| notify on\|off]` | update: changelog first, then confirmation | owners |
